The GAIA Lab is always open to students and researchers interested in artificial
intelligence applied to remote sensing, climate, forests, and agriculture. Fill in
the form below: your application goes straight to the lab coordinator.

```{=html}
<form id="join-form" class="join-form"
      data-idioma="en"
      data-email="dario.oliveira@fgv.br"
      data-endpoint=""
      data-token="troque-por-um-texto-aleatorio"
      data-msg-enviando="Sending..."
      data-msg-ok="Application sent. We will reply by email."
      data-msg-erro="Could not send. Write directly to the address beside the form."
      data-msg-rapido="Please check the fields and send again."
      data-msg-assunto="Interest in joining the GAIA Lab">
  <label for="join-nome">Name</label>
  <input id="join-nome" name="nome" type="text" autocomplete="name" required>

  <label for="join-email">Your email</label>
  <input id="join-email" name="email" type="email" autocomplete="email" required>

  <label for="join-nivel">Intended level</label>
  <select id="join-nivel" name="nivel">
    <option>Undergraduate research</option>
    <option>Master's</option>
    <option>PhD</option>
    <option>Postdoc</option>
    <option>Other</option>
  </select>

  <label for="join-msg">Message</label>
  <textarea id="join-msg" name="mensagem" rows="6" required
            placeholder="Briefly describe your background and research interests"></textarea>

  <input class="join-honeypot" name="website" type="text" tabindex="-1"
         autocomplete="off" aria-hidden="true">

  <button type="submit" class="join-submit">Send application</button>
  <p class="join-status" role="status" aria-live="polite"></p>
</form>

<p class="join-alt">Or write directly to
<a class="email-protect" data-user="dario.oliveira" data-domain="fgv.br" role="button" tabindex="0">dario.oliveira [at] fgv.br</a>
(click to copy the address).</p>

<a class="back-link" href="/">
  <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M15 5l-7 7 7 7"/></svg>
  <span>Back to home</span>
</a>
```
